title: DIRECT: pairs served by an AND with a p-private and an l-private input are at most twice the AND gates (fan-in-two AND/OR circuits)
formal_statement: ∀ (n N M : ℕ) (pw : Fin N → ℕ) (lw : Fin M → ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (A : Finset (Fin N × Fin M)), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → ∀ R : ℕ → ℕ → Prop, R = Relation.ReflTransGen (fun ra rb => ra < rb ∧ ∃ rj, rb = n + rj ∧ rj < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C rj).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ra ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C rj).inputs) → (∀ e ∈ A, ∃ (j a b : ℕ), (j < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ((((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs.getD 0 0) = a ∧ ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs.getD 1 0) = b) ∨ (((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs.getD 0 0) = b ∧ ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs.getD 1 0) = a))) ∧ {x1 : Fin N | R (pw x1) a} = {e.1} ∧ {y1 : Fin M | R (lw y1) b} = {e.2}) → A.card ≤ 2 * {ja : ℕ | ja < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C ja).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and}.ncard
plain_statement: Take an AND/OR circuit, each gate reading exactly two earlier wires; points and lines are input wires. Let A be a set of point-line pairs (p, l) such that some AND gate has one input whose shadow (inputs with an OR-only path to it) among the points is exactly p and the other input whose shadow among the lines is exactly l. Then A has at most twice as many elements as the circuit has AND gates.
